title: GIS BASED INTEGRATED AIRPORT ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM at Cochin International Airport (including 6 years AMC)
scope_summary: The tender seeks a comprehensive GIS-based integrated airport asset management system, including data acquisition, processing, modeling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support. The scope includes ICAO-compliant aerial surveys, high-resolution photogrammetry, DGPS ground control, and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) surveys for surface and subsurface utilities.

title: Procurement & Installation of IIOT based UT sensors at Visakh Refinery
scope_summary: HPCL is inviting tenders for the procurement and installation of IIOT-based Ultrasonic Testing (UT) sensors at its Visakh Refinery. Bidders must submit their offers online via the Government e-Marketplace.

title: Digital Twin solution for A03-A02 stretch of NCRTC
scope_summary: Tender invited for Design, Development, Procurement and ITC (Installation, Testing, and Commissioning) of Digital Twin solution for A03-A02 stretch of NCRTC.
